## Description
Out of the Blue Too Authors: Ian Cowie, Christopher Long, David Jones with a foreword by Air Marshal (Ret’d) Cliff Spink Genre: Biographies & True StoriesLength: 463 pages Chris Long and Dim Jones served in the RAF for 19 and 44 years respectively, and had many stories to tell of their time in the skies, but the question was what to do with them. Thankfully, Chris and Dim, along with their old friend and colleague Ian Cowie, solved the problem by creating the very popular Out of the Blue book trilogy! This was an opportunity to recount some of those tales and also raise many tens of thousands of pounds for military charities, including the Royal Air Force Benevolent Fund. The second volume is a varied collection of amazing and frequently hair-raising stories about flying life. Each book is a separate collection so they do not need to be read in chronological order to enjoy them!
